actions.action: Water thoroughly until it drains, or bottom-water for 15–20 minutes, then empty the saucer
Check the soil and water again when the top inch or two is dry
Inspect the roots for rot or root-binding
If roots are rotten, trim the bad parts and repot into fresh peat/perlite mix in a pot with drainage holes
If showering it, use lukewarm water and let the crown dry thoroughly
Use filtered, distilled, or rainwater for watering
Place a humidifier near the plant to keep humidity around 50%+
Check the leaf undersides for spider mites or thrips
Trim dead or badly damaged leaves at the base
Move it to bright indirect light with stable temperatures, away from drafts and vents
Reply with your watering frequency, tap water type, and whether the pot has drainage holes
